name: Replicate
description: Run-any-model hub with the cleanest async submit-then-poll API in the market: read the account, browse curated collections, inspect a specific model, and poll or list predictions. Every read here is a zero-spend authed GET. Starting a prediction (POST /predictions) is a billable generation, so it is modelled write:true and HITL-gated; the poll tool GET /predictions/{id} is the read half of that async pair and the reference shape every other submit-then-poll connector on this factory copies.

tools.name: get_account
tools.description: Get the Replicate account that owns this API token: username and account type. The cheap balance-free identity read and the spec's auth-proving call

tools.name: list_collections
tools.description: List Replicate's curated model collections (e.g. text-to-image, language-models), each with a name and slug

tools.name: get_model
tools.description: Get a specific public model by owner and name: description, latest version id, and total run count

owner.description: Model owner (organisation or user), e.g. stability-ai

tools.name: list_models
tools.description: List public models on Replicate, most recent first (browse the catalogue): owner, name, description, run count and latest version id

sort_by.description: Optional field to sort by (API default: latest_version_created_at)

tools.name: get_prediction
tools.description: Poll a prediction by id for its current status and, once finished, its output and run metrics. This is the ASYNC POLL half of the submit-then-poll pattern: create_prediction (write:true) starts a job and returns an id, this tool is the zero-spend authed read that checks on it

id.description: Prediction id returned by create_prediction or list_predictions

tools.name: list_predictions
tools.description: List this account's recent predictions with their id, status and model, most recent first

tools.name: create_prediction
tools.description: Start a new prediction (run a model version against an input). This is the ASYNC SUBMIT half of the submit-then-poll pattern: it is a billable generation, so it is HITL-gated and never fired by the shape-proof harness. Poll the returned id with get_prediction once approved and started

version.description: Model version id to run, from get_model's latest_version_id

input.description: Model-specific input fields (varies per model, see the model's schema)

needs_review: NO LIVE CREDENTIAL AT AUTHORING TIME: this spec is shape-proved blind only. LIVE_PROVEN needs one real r8_ token; the build plan flags /account, /collections, /models/{owner}/{name} and /predictions as all zero-spend authed GETs, so live proof should be clean and free once a token is supplied.

REFERENCE SHAPE: this is the intended template for every other async submit-then-poll connector on the factory (fal.ai next): a write:true submit tool that returns a job id, plus a write:false poll tool (get_prediction here) that reads its status. Copy this split rather than re-deriving it.

get_prediction has no _probe because a real prediction id cannot be known ahead of a submit; the shape-proof harness fires it with a dummy string id, which is sufficient to prove the route and auth wall blind.

vault credentialType 'replicate' already existed in integrationTypeRegistry.js before this build (field api_token, prefix r8_, testEndpoint /v1/collections) and was reused as-is, no new registration added.

AUTH PREFIX: Replicate's docs (2026-09-16 check) state Authorization: Bearer <token> is current, with Authorization: Token <token> kept as a legacy alias; this spec uses auth.type 'bearer'. The vault's own testHeaders (integrationTypeRegistry.js) still sends 'Token', which this build deliberately left untouched (out of scope, reuse-only); a real token should confirm both prefixes still work before anyone relies on the vault's test-connection button matching this spec's behaviour.

REPLACES A PRE-EXISTING SPEC: a declarative replicate.connector.json already existed from an earlier bulk-generation wave (6.5-P5, commit a3e54114), already SHAPE_PROVEN and already counted in connectors.export.json (hence this build leaves the export count at 208 rather than raising it to 209). That version was read-only (get_account, list_predictions, get_prediction, list_models with query filters) and had no submit tool at all. This version REPLACES it to add the create_prediction/get_prediction async submit-poll pair the build plan asked for; get_prediction's tool name is unchanged, but list_models (owner+name filterable list) was dropped in favour of get_model (single owner/name lookup) and list_collections was added. No other file in the repo referenced the dropped tool names at replacement time (grepped clean).
